item.title: Outlook.com Is Silently Rejecting Some Mail From Domains Without DMARC: A 30-Second Self-Check
item.description: Since 2026-11-05 Microsoft's consumer mail partially rejects domains without DMARC, unannounced. A 30-second dig self-check and the p=none-to-p=reject path.
